eva: Nightly eval alert: long-context prompt set 'convo-anchored-v2' failure rate jumped to 18% (baseline ~0.8%). Fail mode: instruction tokens silently dropped ~mid-sequence, answer loses directive. Example log excerpt: ```FAIL at seq 1024: kv_index mismatch: expected 4096 got 4095; stitch returned generic text``` Rolled q8-nightly at 02:12 UTC last night, fyi. Anyone able to triage? :rotating_light:
priyanka: On it. Can you paste the failing sample and which model/kernel combo? Is this only on long-window runs (>=16k)?
ben: I reproduced locally with the sample eva posted. Command I used: ```./eval_runner --model redwood-m-13b --quant q8 --context 16384 --seed 42 --prompt-file fails.txt``` Got the same instruction drop at the 1024 boundary.
sam: Quick thought — we've seen an off-by-one in the prefix-anchor computation when switching kernel codepaths (int8 -> q4/q8). Prefetch/stitch logic uses inclusive/exclusive bounds and a kernel guard was recently changed in the quantized path. Could be the anchor shifted by one slot on eviction.
deploy-bot: Deploy event: q8-nightly pushed to cluster-ml-2 @ 2026-03-18T02:12:17Z by ci/cd. Rollback available: ci/cd rollback-id=ci-2026-03-18-0210.
priyanka: I diffed the kv slot assignments between a good run (non-quant) and failing run (q8). Here are the key lines: ```kv.slot_anchor=2048
kv.slot_offset_before_stitch=0
kv.slot_offset_after_stitch=-1``` That -1 looks suspicious. Hypothesis: when prefix eviction crosses a 1024 boundary, the quantized stitch path decrements anchor incorrectly.
eva: Can you attach the minimal repro and a short trace? If this is a regression from the quant build we should canary-revert the kernel and run the nightly subset. If rollback needed, ping infra.
ben: Uploaded repro + trace to the ticket (link in thread). Trace shows exact token ids around the failure and the `kv.index` sequence. Sample snippet: ```... token(1009) token(1010) ... token(1023) token(1024) -> next response lost instruction token ...```
sam: I'm preparing a micro-patch that normalizes anchor before stitch: ```if (kv.slot_offset < 0) kv.slot_offset = 0;``` It's naive but should confirm the root cause. I'll run a canary with the reverted kernel first (rollback to ci-2026-03-18-0210) and then apply patch on a single node.
priyanka: Filed TICKET-3241 with eval diffs, attach traces, and assigned owners: @ben repro, @sam kernel/patch, @eva monitor. Added nightly-eval tags and priority P0 because this affects instruction fidelity.
eva: Thanks. Run the 50-sample longctx subset on the canary after rollback and paste the pass/fail counts here. If it stays bad after rollback, we widen scope to other infra.
ben: Will run now and report back in ~20m.
sam: I'll start the rollback canary and then apply the patch if rollback improves results.
priyanka: For the ticket I included a short diagnostic script that reproduces the anchor shift reliably (seeded). Use `--seed 42` as ben did.
eva: Good. Keep this thread for updates. If someone needs ops escalation, call out @eng-sre. :thumbsup:
